page_title: AUX 0-1 HAV | Auxerre v Le Havre 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+256' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Thomas Delaine (Le Havre) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) is caught offside!
90+5' Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
90+4' The referee points to the corner flag and Auxerre will take a corner.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' The yellow card goes to Danny Namaso (Auxerre).
88' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
87' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Gideon Mensah will be replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
87' The ball is out of play. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Here comes a substitution. Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Senaya.
81' A corner kick by Auxerre is thwarted by the well prepared Mory Diaw (Le Havre).
80' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Auxerre.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
79' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) replacing Yassine Kechta.
79' It's time for a substitution. Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) comes on in place of Rassoul Ndiaye.
75' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Le Havre! Play can continue.

74' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
74' Donovan Leon makes a decent save to thwart the attempt by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).
73' Surely that's handball by one of the Auxerre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
73' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
73' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Sekou Mara is replaced by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre).
68' Substitution. Josue Casimir did his best and is replaced by Rudy Matondo (Auxerre).
67' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
67' Auxerre get a corner.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Auxerre.
66' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
63' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Substitution. Ally Samatta leaves the pitch and is replaced by Younes Namli (Le Havre).
59' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
58' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' The linesman raises his flag. Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is adjudged offside.
52' Mory Diaw blocks Josue Casimir (Auxerre)'s effort from the edge of the box.
51' Le Havre have a corner.
47' 0 - 1 What a hit! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
46' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Assane Diousse (Auxerre) comes on the pitch for Elisha Owusu.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' What a chance! Ally Samatta (Le Havre) blasts a first-time shot from inside the box that rattles the left post.
42' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
41' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows the yellow card to Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) for a heavy challenge.
37' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
36' The corner is swung in but Auxerre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) unleashes a close-range volley low towards the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
33' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) sees a yellow card from Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

28' Mory Diaw pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Danny Namaso (Auxerre) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Auxerre fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
27' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
25' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul after Issa Soumare (Le Havre) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' The resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared.

17' It's unbelievable, Ally Samatta (Le Havre) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Donovan Leon reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
17' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
15' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' The game is interrupted now, Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
12' Poor challenge! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is penalised for tripping and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle. Auxerre have a free kick.
10' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
6' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
4' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
3' A quickly taken corner by Auxerre.
2' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Auxerre will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
